timestamp_basis: Tool-recording time during the current turn; original user-message transport timestamp is unavailable.
source: Current task user request relayed verbatim by the root operator to the SDD owner; standing constraints and mechanism decision relayed in the same task.
message: I need the sound problem to be fixed!
scope: Repair Preview and incoming-message sound through browser media-element playback while preserving the current consultation and saved preferences.
standing_constraints: Do not interrupt the current consultation.
Do not reload the running application tab or restart the server.
Preserve the exact accepted Knock v5 asset, model/effort choices, private authentication/state and frozen Electric A v8.
confirmed_implementation_decision: Use one persistent HTMLAudioElement per session across supported browsers. A trusted gesture plays a finite 50 ms all-zero WAV to natural completion, then stages the saved sound on that same element. Incoming alerts rewind/replay it; an unsaved Preview temporarily changes its source and restores the saved source without changing preferences. Remove Web Audio and AudioSession overrides.
evidence_limits: The owner reports silent Preview and incoming sound in native Safari despite internal Web Audio activity; internal events are not proof of audibility.
The mechanism is an authorized implementation decision; actual browser checks and any current-tab recovery are recorded separately.
No physical-device listening success, unchanged-consultation runtime result or formal QA pass is inferred.
